title: Join the allminus lifetime to the correct unconditioned mean
statement: A monotone coupling to a zero-field phase-restricted process yields a startup-controlled full hitting-mean comparison.

evidence.quote: P2 — complete normally visible rare-transition construction return

requires: Periodic LxL square Ising torus,n=L^2,H=-J sum_edges sigma_i sigma_j-h sum sigma_i,heatbath rate1/(1+exp(beta DeltaH)),ONE rate1 proposal clock PER SITE. Allminus a,target B={M>=0};T_h=E_a tau_B. theta=beta J fixed sufficiently low temperature,R=J/h grows,C R<=L<=R^p for fixed C,p>1. Requested high-probability multiplicative(1+epsilon) interval with TOTAL work polynomial(n,R,input bits,epsilon^-1,log delta^-1) remains NOT PROVED.
provides: nu0_minus=pi0(.|M<=0),u_h(x)=E_x tau_B,m_h=nu0_minus(u_h). If reflected zero-field Y_s from allminus is within eta TV of nu0_minus,then m_h<=T_h<=(s+m_h)/(1-eta). This is not a quasi-stationary or survival-conditioned mean.

Special ground-start phase control plus canonical fallback gap^-1<=2n^2(1+exp(8theta))exp(16theta(L+1)) must respect source regimes. Existing q=2 random-cluster sampling plus reject M>0 has acceptance>=1/2; not a new equilibrium sampler.
If startup s is not negligible relative epsilon*m,comparison gives a direct simulation branch T=O(s/epsilon),with E tau^2<=2T^2 and paid truncation/caps. Additive startup terms are retained.
